item.title: VoIP Numbering Comments Due March 16
item.description: Comments are due March 16, replies April 13, on the FCC's further NPRM about expanding its VoIP numbering authorization rules, the Wireline Bureau said Tuesday. Commissioners approved the item in December (see [Ref:2512180052]).
